Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (1.5T only): spatial field gradient ≤ 720 G/cm; slew rate ≤ 100 T/m/s per axis; whole body SAR not to exceed 2 W/kg; No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session; Wait 30 minutes before the next imaging session; Body transmit coil or head transmit coil.
